aboutGame.title: What is ANOMALITH?
paragraphs: ANOMALITH is a psychological survival action game developed and published by FURYU Corporation. You play as 17-year-old Reona Minazuki, diving into reality-bending Anomaly Zones to recover anomalous materials and uncover what happened to her missing friend in a ruined Showa-era Japan.

Every excursion follows the same three-phase loop: Dive into a quarantined sector, Retrieve whatever you can carry, and Return to the extraction point before the Anomalies close in. Between runs the Workshop turns salvaged materials into weapon upgrades, gear, and Anomalization Skills, while the Instability Engine trades your stability for biological firepower. Our wiki covers the whole system with walkthroughs, data tables, boss breakdowns, and step-by-step guides.

faq.description: Quick answers to the questions ANOMALITH players ask most, from platforms and release timing to the demo, combat, and boss preparation.

items.question: What is ANOMALITH?
items.answer: ANOMALITH is a psychological survival action game from FURYU Corporation. You play as 17-year-old Reona Minazuki, diving into reality-bending Anomaly Zones to retrieve anomalous materials and uncover what happened to her missing friend.

items.question: When does ANOMALITH release and on which platforms?
items.answer: ANOMALITH launches on October 28, 2026 for PC via Steam, PlayStation 5, and Nintendo Switch 2, with full controller support. The early purchase bonus window runs from October 29 to November 11, 2026 JST.

items.question: Is there an ANOMALITH demo?
items.answer: Yes. The free ANOMALITH demo is downloaded from the Steam store page and covers the opening sectors, the Dive, Retrieve, Return loop, Workshop crafting, and a check against the official PC system requirements.

items.question: Does ANOMALITH demo progress carry over to the full game?
items.answer: The ANOMALITH demo is a standalone slice of the opening sectors, while pre-order and Digital Deluxe bonus items are granted to your profile once you unlock the Workshop and Shooting Range in the full release.

items.question: Is ANOMALITH multiplayer or co-op?
items.answer: No. ANOMALITH is designed as a single-player, story-driven survival experience focused on solo resource management, atmospheric exploration, and narrative mystery.

items.question: How do I prepare for the ANOMALITH boss fight?
items.answer: Take a weapon upgraded at the Workshop, carry sanity recovery items for the Operating Room encounter, and learn the three boss phases: the Calculated Scalpel, the aerial ambush, and the desperation frenzy below 35% health.
